full_prompt_en: The image is a square graphic action illustration of two masked armed figures, set against distressed scarlet and pink planes. In the background, overlapping crimson rectangles and fine vertical lines build an abstract field across the centre and left, with scraped patches and mottled paint at the edges. Along the right border, a pale pink masonry wall has visible horizontal joints and a rough surface, standing behind both figures. The smaller rear figure occupies the upper centre and right, with the lower body hidden behind the person in front. A dark helmet, goggles and face covering merge into shadow above a red-lit jacket and bulky vest. Both gloved hands hold a rifle against the shoulder, with its barrel extending left on a shallow upward diagonal and its curved magazine pointing down. Across the lower half, the larger foreground figure leans forward at a lower level, cropped below the torso. A dark green helmet carries broad black goggles above the eyes; the eyes remain visible through an opening in a black face covering. Grey-green sleeves carry pale pink highlights, with a round light patch on the upper arm and dark straps crossing the shoulder. The nearer rifle also points left, nearly parallel to the one above, its fore-end gripped by a gloved hand and its curved magazine descending near the centre-left. Dark pouches and overlapping vest panels fill the lower-right edge. Broad frontal illumination picks out fabric folds and hard equipment edges, while red ambient colour warms exposed surfaces and deep shadow gathers beneath the helmets. The overall composition stacks two leftward aiming silhouettes against vertical graphic blocks, balancing textured warm colour with dark, tightly rendered forms.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形图形化动作插画，两名蒙面武装人物置于带磨损纹理的猩红与粉色平面前。背景中央及左侧由交叠的深红矩形、纤细竖线组成抽象色域，边缘分布刮擦和斑驳颜料痕迹。右边框沿线是一面浅粉色砌块墙，可见水平接缝与粗糙表面，位于两人身后。体量较小的后方人物占据上部中央及右侧，下身被前方人物遮住。深色头盔、护目镜和面罩沉入阴影，下方夹克和厚背心映着红光。双只戴手套的手将枪抵在肩边，枪管沿略向上的斜线朝左伸出，弯曲弹匣向下。画面下半部，较大的前景人物处于较低位置，身体前倾，躯干以下被画边裁掉。深绿色头盔上架着宽黑护目镜，位于双眼上方；眼睛从黑色面罩的开口中露出。灰绿衣袖带浅粉亮部，上臂有浅色圆形贴片，深色带子斜过肩部。前景枪支同样朝左，与上方枪支近乎平行，一只戴手套的手握住前段，弯曲弹匣在左侧偏中部向下伸出。深色装备袋及交叠背心面片填满右下缘。宽阔的正面照明勾出衣褶与硬质装备边缘，红色环境色使受光表面偏暖，头盔下方则积着深影。整体将两道朝左瞄准的轮廓上下叠放，与竖向图形色块交织，在富有纹理的暖色与刻画紧密的暗色形体之间形成平衡。
style_prompt_en: Graphic digital illustration joins sharply modelled forms with distressed flat colour fields. Saturated scarlet, crimson and coral pink contrast with charcoal and muted green-grey, while small pale highlights define selected edges. Scraped patches, uneven pigment and fine linear overlays interrupt broad rectangular shapes without obscuring the focal silhouettes. Layered forms compress the depth, and repeated shallow diagonals cross stronger vertical divisions to create directional tension. Broad frontal light produces clear material folds and bright rims against deep compact shadows. The overall treatment balances poster-like colour separation, worn surface texture and dense dimensional detail.
style_prompt_zh: 图形化数码插画将明暗清晰的立体形态与磨损感平面色域结合起来。高饱和猩红、深红和珊瑚粉对照炭黑及低饱和绿灰，小面积浅色高光界定部分边缘。刮擦斑块、不均匀颜料和细线叠层打断大块矩形，又不掩盖主要轮廓。层叠形体压缩纵深，重复的缓斜线穿过较强的竖向分区，形成方向张力。宽阔正面光塑造清楚的材质褶皱与明亮边缘，对照集中深影。整体在海报般色彩分区、磨损表面和密集立体细节之间保持平衡。
theme_en: Two masked armed figures aim their rifles left beside a pale pink wall.
theme_zh: 两名蒙面武装人物在浅粉色墙边，持枪共同瞄向左侧。
name: Counter-Strike
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
